ns2:course.label: Molec & Cellular Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Introductory laboratory course focusing on basic techniques in molecular and cellular biology. Credit is not given for MCB 151 for students majoring in Molecular and Cellular Biology, or Integrative Biology. Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment in MCB 150.
